meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 你说“开个站会”后，Claude 把每个代码分支和 PR 当成一个参会者，让它们在后台轮流发言，比较改了什么、哪里重叠或冲突，最后凝聚成一份合并计划——以哪个分支为基础、按什么顺序合并、哪些由你拍板。它全程只读，不会真的执行合并。
howto.when: 当你要求给 git 工作区、分支或开放 PR 安排一场站会，或说想比较这些改动并整理成一份整合计划时，Claude 会作为协调者召集相关分支的虚拟代理开会。

say.text: 帮我把这几个分支开个站会，整理成一份合并计划。
say.note: Claude 会召集各分支代理，得出整合方案。

say.text: 比较我所有工作树和开放 PR，给出合并顺序和冲突点。
say.note: 会先只读收集改动，再按轮次对比。

say.text: 让 main 之外的分支和那个 PR 互相讨论，给出取舍建议。
say.note: Claude 会定向邀请相关代理解决重叠和冲突。

howto.what_en: Claude turns each branch/PR into a chat participant that compares changes and conflicts, then agrees on one merge plan (base branch, merge order, open decisions). Read-only; no actual merging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run a standup over git worktrees, branches, or PRs, or to compare the changes and produce one consolidation plan.

say_en.text: Run a standup over these branches and give me one merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude convenes branch agents and outputs one consolidation plan.

say_en.text: Compare my worktrees and open PRs; suggest merge order and flag conflicts.
say_en.note: Claude gathers the changes and runs round-based reconciliation.

say_en.text: Have the extra branches and that PR talk it out; tell me what to keep.
say_en.note: Claude invites the implicated agents to resolve overlaps.
